declaration.rule_verbatim: The window must contain, for EVERY input in the fusion's population, either (a) at least TWO OBSERVED CHANGES of that input, or (b) an explicit FROZEN declaration for it.

A window resting on DECLARED cadence rests on a field absent two thirds of the time and wrong in a majority of checked cases. OBSERVED change is the right input.

reading_note_which_window.carried_here_because: the clarification arrived as a broker message and this artifact is the durable carrier that outlives it. A correction is only as complete as its last surviving carrier -- this project has twice paid for a fix that landed in one carrier and not the one readers actually open.
reading_note_which_window.clarification: THIS CENSUS MEASURES ALL HISTORY AT HEAD, so it answers 'has this input EVER moved twice'. That SIZES THE FLOOR -- an input that has never moved twice in its whole history will not move twice in 7 nights, which is the frozen-or-slow signal. It is NOT the in-window census. L4-C02's GATE census is re-run at L4 by the same instrument over the N-run window (commits between run 1 and run N per input), and THAT verdict is the gate.
reading_note_which_window.therefore: `verdict.l4c02_satisfied: false` here MUST NOT be read as 'L4-C02 fails'. It is the floor-sizing input reporting that two inputs have not yet been observed to move twice in all of history.
reading_note_which_window.and_at_l4: the declarant states that `andrew_record` (a sovereign record) and `boundary_declarations` (the declaration file) are DOCUMENTS that BIND the experiment, not fusion inputs whose nightly drift a persistence rate must survive -- waiting for a ruling to change twice is not a persistence measurement. At L4 they are declared FROZEN-BY-KIND by the declarant and the census then reads 6 observed + 2 frozen = 8 of 8.
reading_note_which_window.NOT_APPLIED_HERE_AND_WHY: the declarant explicitly did NOT ask this lane to declare them frozen now: 'declaring inputs frozen is L4's act on its own window, and doing it in wave 2 would be the declarant reaching into the executor's artifact to make the verdict read clean.' No frozen_declaration was set. The census stands as emitted and its verdict is unchanged.
